brief: Idle/incremental cultivation game (xianxia fantasy), 'The Long Road to Heaven'. The player is a cultivator refining Qi to break through realms of power toward immortality and 'Open Heaven'. Tone: reverent and mythic with a temple-and-sect aesthetic, evocative power-fantasy (not grimdark). Address the player as a cultivator. Use established xianxia/wuxia terminology and keep it consistent (see glossary). 'Qi' is the core energy resource: use the standard cultivation term (zh: 气, ja: 気, ko: 기; keep 'Qi' or 'Chi' in Latin-script languages), never generic 'energy'. Realm and stage names are cultivation ranks; render them evocatively and consistently. In-game resources/items (Blood Lotus, Spirit Dew, Karma, Merit, Qi Spark, Foundation Pill, Qi Crystal) are not literal objects. Keep strings terse for a tight mobile UI. Preserve all {{placeholders}} and **markdown**/<strong> tags exactly.

terms.context: Core energy resource (appears 255x). Standard cultivation term: 气 (zh), 気 (ja), 기 (ko); keep 'Qi'/'Chi' in Latin scripts. Never 'energy'.
The Way (道). Transliterate ('Dao'/'Tao') or use the established rendering.
The xianxia practice of refining qi to gain power (修炼/修行); the game's core activity.
One who cultivates; the player (修士/修仙者).
A major cultivation power tier (境界). Same word every time.
A sub-division/step within a Realm, toward the next Realm.
Advancing past a layer/realm gate (突破).
The player's cultivation order/clan (宗门).
A sect member; the basic producer unit (弟子).
The crystal the player refines/taps for qi gain. Keep consistent.
A buff card offered on breakthroughs (符). Keep consistent.
An alchemy product / consumable buff (丹).
A permanent-buff pill from the furnace (筑基丹); distinct from a regular Pill.
Qi channels in the body (经络); 'Meridian Furnace' is a producer.
Reincarnation currency earned on rebirth, spent on the Eternal Tree (业/功德).
The prestige reset; also 'Rebirth' (转生/重生).
Currency that powers the disciple Roster minigame.
A brewed buff from the Spirit Garden.
The cost/offering to buy a producer (the buy action on producer cards).
Premium (paid) currency (血莲). Evocative, not literal 'blood'.
The Spirit Garden's own currency (灵露).
The reincarnation skill tree spent with Karma.
A special boost qi (the petition/ad reward). Not weather: zh MUST be 天之气, never 天气.
A tappable golden-orb spark/upgrade (golden-cookie style boost). Not weather: zh MUST be 神之气, never 天气.
A high cultivation realm/title (圣).
